name: Surging Totem
tooltip:
Surging Totem
Talent
6.5% of base mana40 yd range
Instant25 sec cooldown
Requires Shaman
Enhancement
Summons a totem at the target location that creates a Tremor immediately and every 6 sec for (122.382% of Attack Power) Flamestrike damage. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets. Lasts 25 sec.

Restoration
Summons a totem at the target location that maintains Healing Rain with 10% increased effectiveness for 25 sec.

Replaces Healing Rain.
